visual_enhancers.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, links, dropdown items, tabs, menu items, and key metric texts MUST include role-based kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn', data-testid='portal-profile-card', data-testid='teacher-profile-tab', data-testid='student-dob-field').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application strictly renders in `.js` / `.jsx` React files.
Implement light and dark mode toggling seamlessly with clean Tailwind classes (`dark:bg-slate-900`, `dark:text-slate-100`).
Make the Student Portal design vibrant, playful, and high-energy with rounded-2xl/rounded-3xl cards, colorful stat badges, animated streak counters, and clear leader badges.
Implement the My Profile details card/view for both Student Portal (Student details + Guardian Info) and Teacher Workspace (Teacher Credentials + Classes/Subjects load).
Do NOT use Space Grotesk font or AI gradient purple #7351B7.
Ensure adaptive density across screens and exact data-testid attributes on all interactive and metric elements for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid centered layouts for dense data views. Left-align text and structural content.
Never use dark color gradients. Use flat dark backgrounds with subtle 1px border outlines.
Do not use transparent backgrounds without backdrop filters for floating/sticky navigation header bars.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, links, chips, badges, and text metric containers have kebab-case data-testid attributes.
